groups.title: Non-tax federal revenue – outside the tax total

defaults.basis: Cash basis, executed revenue ('recaudado') as reported in the public account

observations.caveat: Federal fees and oil revenue are non-tax income, so they lie outside the national total and keep the neutral size. Includes derechos on water, mining and other assets; excludes oil-related payments, which are in the oil-revenue core.

observations.locator: Ingresos petroleros del Gobierno Federal: Fondo Mexicano del Petróleo 239,823.2 + ISR contratistas y asignatarios (40.0) (recaudado 2025)
observations.caveat: Federal fees and oil revenue are non-tax income, so they lie outside the national total and keep the neutral size. Revenue from PEMEX's own sales of oil is counted separately in public-sector revenue and is not part of this core.
